name: dsh-course-subtitles
description: DSH dual-half plugin: extract course video subtitles (DeepLearning.AI, YouTube, Bilibili, Coursera), rebuild them as whole sentences, translate line-by-line (EN/ZH), generate section headings, and publish one Feishu doc per lesson under a parent node. Also exports a Course Outline (video titles as plain text, week/module blocks preserved) into one Feishu doc. Every credential comes from the environment or the harness credential store — nothing is hardcoded, and the LLM key chain falls back automatically.
